title: Equations of parallel and perpendicular lines

sections.heading: Core Concepts: Equations of parallel and perpendicular lines

questions.q: In $\triangle ABC$ studying equations of parallel and perpendicular lines, $m\angle A = 45^\circ$ and $m\angle B = 45^\circ$. What is $m\angle C$?
questions.answer: Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (45^\circ + 45^\circ) = 90^\circ$.

questions.q: A geometric figure scaled by factor $k = 2$ has an original side length of $4\text{ cm}$. What is the corresponding image length?
questions.answer: Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $4 \times 2 = 8\text{ cm}$.

questions.q: On the coordinate plane, a line with slope $m = 5$ passes through $(0, 4)$. What is its $y$-coordinate when $x = 1$?
